about: David P. Ackerman is an attorney who represents clients in the West Palm Beach, Florida area. David Ackerman is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Ackerman chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended The George Washington University Law School and graduated in 1982. David Ackerman passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1983.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Professional Liability: Defense issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Ackerman has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
